text: Sammbowel e minyiragel muɓɓoy na o noddira ɗum Kummbowel Kodda.
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: Nder luuro waande o wuuridi e ɓiɓɓe makko.
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: Nder luuro waande to debbo men resata ɓiɓɓem de dilla tewtiiru nyaamdu.
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: o daroo daande waande ɗoon de na o wi'a:
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: Na worndi noon faa wari ɓooyi.
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: Njannde gom njuuraa juwi debbo men na musinnina ɓikkoy mum.
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: O suuɗii gaɗa wuumoore heɓa debbo dilla de o lutta o ada ɓiɓɓem o hirsowa o nyaama.
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: Ɓikkoy musinnoo ni ndoggi naati nder luuro waande.
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: Nyannde gom njuuraa warti moggii gaɗa waande.
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: Inna koreeji yottinoo daanda waande ni fuɗɗi:
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: Ɗum anndunoo inna koreeji dillii ni ɗum lutti.
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: Njuuraa yottinoo daande waande ni fuɗɗi:
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: Njuuraa yottinnoo ni kummbowel Kodda jaabii wi'i:
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: Kummbowel Kodda annditii koo daande nde,
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: Ɗum yottinoo ni ɗum darii daande waande dagu no woowirnoo nih:
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: Mawniragel amin le waaway senndi daande maa e daande nyemmintinɗo ma.
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: ɓe tinnoo ta ɓe mbuytoo so wanaa kanko tawaa.
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: Ni o dillani tewtoyde njaamdu nder ladde.
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: Yottinoo daande waande ni wi'i ko woowunoo wi'ude.
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: Innam ƴami ɗum toy Sammbowel woni.
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: Heddii kummbowel Kodda e innam mbattiti lunnde.
title: 11 Inna Kummbowel Kodda

text: debbo e cukalel mum na wi'ee Girbel.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Nyannde gom Girbel yoppaa kam tan wuro.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Ɓe mbi'i ɓe ndewan nder wuro ɓe tewta ndiyam ɓe njara.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Girbel yi'unoo sukaaɓe worɓe ni ummii heɓa joota ɓoy.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Ɓe mboɗɗinoo seeɗa ni gooto maɓɓe ƴami:
title: 14 Girbel

text: "Anndi ɗume cukalel deel lobbel ngel leɓdi on?"
title: 14 Girbel

text: Gooto jaabii wi'i yiɗaanaa tawenoo o yaaye gootom;
title: 14 Girbel

text: Tataɓo jaabii wi'i koo walaa fu ko Girbel leɓdi so wanaa laɓi daande.
title: 14 Girbel

text: wi'i yeggitii saayam wuro ngo ɓe mbittii ngo.
title: 14 Girbel

text: annditii koo Girbel o haajaa yeeƴanaade.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Heddii ɓe mbi'i ta o yeeƴoo koo ɓe kokkoran o saaya.
title: 14 Girbel

text: O warowi o wi'i o yeggitii sarla makko wuro ngo ɓe mbittii ngo.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Heddii ɗiɗo ɓe mbi'i ta o yeeƴo koo ɓe kokkoran o sarla.
title: 14 Girbel

text: O warowi o wi'i o yeeƴoto wuro ngo ɓe mbittii ngo saboo o yeggitii yonki makko.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Jaadiraaɓe makko mbi'i o yeeƴoo ndelle,
title: 14 Girbel

text: saboo ɓoy ngalaa yonki ɓoy kokka o.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Nde suka gorko yottinoo ɗo Girbel ni ɗaɓɓi ndiyam yara.
title: 14 Girbel

text: O ƴami Girbel ko saabii de hokki o ndiyam tuunuɗam.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Girbel wi'i hokkay o ndiyam tuunuɗam saboo yuuguure innam itti ɗam,
title: 14 Girbel

text: ɗo ɗum wari heɓa ɗum rappitoo ɗoon,
title: 14 Girbel

text: Inna Girbel sippidinnoo kosammum ni ɓoylitanii wuro.
title: 14 Girbel

text: o fii wullaandu de o ƴami moy waɗani o nih Girbel makko.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Suka suuɗinoo na ndaara Girbel na waree.
title: 14 Girbel

text: O itti o fillanii inna Girbel ko o yi'i.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Ɗo inna Girbel yottii fu ƴama:
title: 14 Girbel

text: Mioy njuuloowo njanngoowo yi'ani kam Girbel
title: 14 Girbel

text: Mo o ƴami fu jaaboo o:
title: 14 Girbel

text: Nih faa ɗo o tukkowi gorko gomma.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Suka gorko wi'i yo kam wari Girbel.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Inna Girbel jaabii wi'i kanko pay haajaa waɗa gorum.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Ni ɓe ndewondiri ɓe kondi wuro suka gorko.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Nde weetunoo fu suka gorko wentori.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Inna Girbel tewti laɓi taƴii hoore makko wubbi e conndi waɗi ba sobbere nih.
title: 14 Girbel

text: O tewti horde mawnde o watti hoore suka gorko de o ɓeedi cobbe togoose.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Ni o fawiri wuro inna suka gorko.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Inna Girbel yottinoo wuro esiraaɓem ni ƴamani suudu esum debbo.
title: 14 Girbel

text: O hollaa ɗo suudu nduun woni.
title: 14 Girbel

text: O tawi esiyo o yo neewu.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Ley ɗo o neewi ɗo fu,
title: 14 Girbel

text: diiro makko na ɓuri diro jokolle.
title: 14 Girbel

text: O wi'i o monoke o mooroke saboo dey ɓiiko warii heɓa ndaara o.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Debbo neejo itti cobbe yeɗi hoddiraaɓe.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Wari heddi sobbere ɓurunde fu ɓuttidilde.
title: 14 Girbel

text: O adi nde o wi'i o feccan o waɗa cemmbam.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Ni o hawri wuyko ɓiiko gorko.
title: 14 Girbel

text: O ƴami inna Girbel sobbere ɗumeere waddani o.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Inna Girbel fillanii o ko ɓiiko waɗi Girbel mum.
title: 14 Girbel

text: Ndelle so neɗɗo na waɗa ko boni fu,
title: 14 Girbel

text: Jemma e nyalooma fu yo kamɓe njaadannoo.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Ɗuuɓi o fuɗɗiri filaade dey kaananke o heɓay.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Alla resi en reeni en faa nyannde gom dey kaananke wi'i waran hiiro makko.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Arande so dey kaananke yehii hiiro gorko,
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: nyaw mbonngu ngu hantataako nanngata ɗum.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: innam e bammum fu tappete mbaree.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Ndelle de suka debbo wayninoo ko hootan,
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Heddii sukaaɓe worɓe men ƴamondiri ko ngaɗata.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Ko ɓuurti le ɓuray nde ɓe mbari dey kaananke.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Ɓe mooɓi o nder suudu Kaaldo,
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Lettugal e gorgal fu dey kaananke yo yeeyete.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Worndi noon faa Kaaldo warowi waɗi ko jom yonki.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Jeɗɗiire ruuɗii warti fu Sammbo deƴƴay.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Heddii suudu baaba hawriti ndaari ko jey waɗude heɓa Sammbo deƴƴinoo.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Kaananke leydi wi'i na anndi ko watta.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: ɓuroriri njokollaaku de ɓuroriri wodde tagu.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Kaananke wi'i Sammbo suɓoo gooto maɓɓe waɗa jaadom,
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Heddii Sammbo e jaadom keso na njaada.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Wari nyannde gom ndawuuwa kaananke lalli.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: O nanngi nga o mooɓi de o itti ndamndiri makko mbaala ngootiri o hirsi.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: defaa de o baantii jaadiiko wara ɓe nyaama.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Nde ɓe nyaamunoo ɓe nyaamdi ni Sammbo wi'i jaadom koo tewu ngu,
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Ni ɓe njehi ɓe pukkowii ɓe ɗaanii.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Tawi kaananke na jooɗii Alla e ronku ɗoyɗi illa ndawuuwa nga lalli.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Min kiiri seeɗa de min ummii heɓa min pukkowoo.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: o haalani kam koo teewu ngu,
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Mi anndaa fu no ɗum wa'ni kam.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Ndelle mbi'u-mi mi waran mi haalane heɓa yimɓe tewtoyɓe ndawuuwa nga,
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: hiirtaa de heddaa heɓa fummee hasaaki naatuɓe ladde na tewta njiita ɗum."
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Sammbo ummaninoo jonnde makko heɓa ɓe njootondira fu,
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Sammbo ƴamtinii ko saabii de na haɓɓee.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Walaa fu ko mi waɗanay ma nde Kaaldo maynoo heɓa wayloo koo nih njoɓirtaa kam.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Koo aan Sammbo yarlotoo hirsa ndawuuwa am."
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Fay yi'i cofal kaananke nanngan mooɓa,
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Kaananke ƴami noy de o waɗi ndawuuwam jonngaa ndelle.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Sammbo haalani kaananke no fu yaari.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: O wi'i o yi'i ndawuuwa kaananke,
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: o nanngii ɗum o mooɓii heɓa naange nyawla de o hoora ɗum.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Teewu ngu o hawti jaadiiko o nyaami ngu,
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Kanko du o haɓɓitowi ndawuuwa kaananke o waɗi.
title: 16 Ndawuuwa kaananke

text: Ko o muuyi fu ɗuum o hokkortee.
title: 17 Jiija

text: Nyannde gom o naati ladde na o waancoo.
title: 17 Jiija

text: O tawi mboddi na nyaama kaareeje.
title: 17 Jiija

text: O noddi ndi faa ndi nootii de o ƴami:
title: 17 Jiija

text: " Noy de na a nyaama kaareeje.
title: 17 Jiija

text: Jiija ndaari mboddi faa neeɓi de watti wi'i:
title: 17 Jiija

text: koo fay kedde ndiibiri am heƴii ma.
title: 17 Jiija

text: Ni ɓe ndewondiri ɓe kooti wuro Jiija en.
title: 17 Jiija

text: Nde ɓe njottinoo ɓe pootini fu,
title: 17 Jiija

text: Jiija naatowi nder suudu wuytini neema hokki mboddi.
title: 17 Jiija

text: Jiija wuytini ko woni nder suudu fu hokki mboddi.
title: 17 Jiija

text: So mboddi nyaamii nyaamidii ni wi'a,
title: 17 Jiija

text: O heddii o hucciti yimɓe makko na o yima:
title: 17 Jiija

text: Ndi moɗunoo dammuce ni ndi watti ndi wi'i Jiijaa mi haaray.
title: 17 Jiija

text: Jiija heddii hucciti bammum wi'i kuunga mannga haaray.
title: 17 Jiija

text: Baabiyo o waɗi kaddi maral mum fu waddaa.
title: 17 Jiija

text: Ko waddaa fu mboddi jaɓa moɗa de wi'a haaray.
title: 17 Jiija

text: Wari walaa fu ko ndi hokkee.
title: 17 Jiija

text: Mboddi nanngi ɗum moɗi de watti wi'i:
title: 17 Jiija

text: Ni mboddi men jaɓi ɗeen du moɗi.
title: 17 Jiija

text: Inna Jiija e Baaba Jiija mbuyti.
title: 17 Jiija

text: yimɓe mbi'i suka leeɓaa eetee faa ƴaɓitoo.
title: 17 Jiija

text: gorko wonnoo de walaa njaaliɗo ɗum.
title: 18 Addaare

text: Wari o nani koo kaananke woni faa njenndi e banndum;
title: 18 Addaare

text: Dokkal ngaal yo fiiloto na warta.
title: 18 Addaare

text: Ndee ɓaade hokki ɓiɗɗo debbo hikka,
title: 18 Addaare

text: Yeru suka debbo mo ɗum fodii hokkude o,
title: 18 Addaare

text: Walaa fu ɗo innde makko e haala ŋari makko,
title: 18 Addaare

text: e haala ndimaaku makko e haala yurmeende makko njahay.
title: 18 Addaare

text: Nde o yottinoo ndewngu kaananke fu,
title: 18 Addaare

text: "Ndee suka debbo ɓii-laamu o sakkoytee weendu ndu?"
title: 18 Addaare

text: So waɗii seeɗa a faaman bawɗi makko na piya;
title: 18 Addaare

text: Addaare ƴami ndu le suudu wi'etee cuurel bonngel.
title: 18 Addaare

text: "Cuurel bonngel yo suudu nyiɓaa na woni tiinde maayo.
title: 18 Addaare

text: Nder toon suka debbo mo kaalataa haalam o,
title: 18 Addaare

text: Ni Addaare ɗaɓɓi debbo neejo sappowoo ɗum cuurel bonngel.
title: 18 Addaare

text: Heddii debbo neejo e Addaare ardondiri faa e cuurel.
title: 18 Addaare

text: ɓee to yo njiman maa mbulan.
title: 18 Addaare

text: Addaare anndunoo koo yimɓe fu ndillidii ni yottii hiirni suka debbo jam.
title: 18 Addaare

text: ba njooɗiiɗo hakkunde innam e bammum.
title: 18 Addaare

text: Suka debbo ƴamataa ko waddi o,
title: 18 Addaare

text: kanko o ƴamataa suka debbo ko waddi ɗum.
title: 18 Addaare

text: ko so Alla jaɓii mi waran jinnaaru ndu de mi jiline faa e janngo bammaa."
title: 18 Addaare

text: faa o daroke e dammbugal taa jinnaaru nanna hoore sakko moɗam ɓii-laamu.
title: 18 Addaare

text: Addaare jaabii wi'i illa rimaa anndaa kulol.
title: 18 Addaare

text: Kam du yo nanan na haalee.
title: 18 Addaare

text: Suka debbo wi'i ndelle o faama,
title: 18 Addaare

text: Ni Addaare na haɓda e jinnaaru.
title: 18 Addaare

text: So hoore jinnaaru soppaama ni wonnde fuɗa.
title: 18 Addaare

text: Ko'e jeɗɗi Addaare taƴi de sakitii jaaltii jinnaaru.
title: 18 Addaare

text: O wi'i suka debbo wara ɓe koota.
title: 18 Addaare

text: Ni ɓe ndewondiri ɓe mbiiti nder wuro.
title: 18 Addaare

text: Nde ɓe naatunoo nder wuro fu,
title: 18 Addaare

text: ɓoy taaɓorii cuurel bonngel dooɗo suka debbo o,
title: 18 Addaare

text: Ɓe njottinoo ni ɓe tawi suudu na weeɗii.
title: 18 Addaare

text: Ɓe annditii koo manngal ladde waraama faa suka debbo dillidaama.
title: 18 Addaare

text: Ɓe ndoggi ɓe kooti ɓe kaalanowi kaananke.
title: 18 Addaare

text: Kaananke haalananoo koo manngal weendu waraama ni waɗi suudu baaba hawrondinaa.
title: 18 Addaare

text: O wi'i na o joganii mbaruɗo manngal weendu ndu moƴƴere.
title: 18 Addaare

text: Heddii neyyel wari haalani kaananke koo beero wardi e suka debbo cakkanooɗo manngal weendu wurom to.
title: 18 Addaare

text: moƴƴere mawnde Alla e kannyum saabii de ɓe kewti weendu maɓɓe;
title: 18 Addaare

text: o hokkoraa suka debbo o du,
title: 18 Addaare

text: Ko foti o yiƴde ngel walaa.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: Wari o maayi o yoppi ngel.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: Ngel tawdaa baabiigel faa ɗum warowi ɗum dewli debbo keso.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: Ko boni fu ɗuum o waɗetee.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: wi'ete o waɗii ko o waɗay.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: Nde weeti fu ngayngum e cukalel ngel yo ɓeedoto.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: Nyannde gom moodibbo wari weerani ɓe.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: Illa wari yo cukalel ngel horanta.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: ni wi'ee o waɗa ɗum to.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: Heddii moodibbo men noddi cukalel ngel ƴami:
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: Moodibbo wi'i hokkoran o dalilii heɓa o yi'a yaaye gooto inniiko.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: Ngel hejji ngel waɗi daliili oon.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: yo yaaye gooto inna cukalel ngel.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: So cukalel gollidii golleejim subaka ni yaka nyallo beero,
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: ni watta yaha hiirowa ɗo beero.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: Ko cukalel ngel yaata to beero o ɗum,
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: So cukalel yottoke ɗo yaaye gooto innam ni wi'a:
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: So jemma hiirii ni hiraande waddee.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: " Hannde kaa accu o wara min kawta min kiirtoo saboo mi woowaa hiirtaade min tan."
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: wi'a cukalel ngel wara ɓoy pukkoo.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: "Oo koo illa innam ƴuwi fukkodaaki goɗɗo.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: hannde kaa min kawtan min pukkoo;
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: o fukkoyto ɗo o woowunoo fukkaade."
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: Cukalel naatondiri e golleejim dagu no e bada nih.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: ndaari o faa wooɗi de ƴami salle nih o wuurdi illa inniikoo ƴuwi.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: Cukalel jaabii wi'i na jaasi no o yi'ri nih.
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: Heddii o waɗani cukalel ko ɓii-aadama remmbe waawaa waɗaneede fu:
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: Nde nawlo inniiko yi'unoo ko o waɗanaa fu semti;
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: moɗam mi ƴuufa mi laatoo waande."
title: 19 Semteende moɗam

text: Nde fini fu o naatan ladde.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Alla e loohooru makko o jogorinoo wuro makko.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Nyannde gom loohotooɗo men dilli loohooru.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: O wari o faami woɓɓe na nodda.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: O tawi noddaandu ndu yo nder ɓunndu ƴuurata.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Walaa fu no ɓe ngaɗay de ɓe mbaaway wuytaade.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: ɓe keddii ɓe ndookii ɗum walla ɓe,
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: O ƴami ɓe salle o wuytinii ɓe,
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Ɓe fu ɓe njaabii ɓe mbi'i ɓe njoɓan.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: O lamndii ɓe faa wooɗi salle ngoonga fu ɓe njoɓowan moƴƴere nde.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Ɓe fu ɓe mbi'i so Alla jaɓii ɓe njoɓan.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Loohotooɗo yehi soppowi leggal wari tummbi nder ɓunndu.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Ɓe nayo fu ɓe ndewi ɓe mbuytii.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Ɓe njootondiri faa jootiiru yottii de mono fu adi laawol mum.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Nyannde gom ɓii-loohotooɗo dilli loohooru de lallowi.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: O anndaa lettugol o anndaa gorgal.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: O heddii na o yaha faa ɗo domka ka,
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: O daasii o yottii nder ɗoogi.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: "Wanaa aan tawdanoo e bammaa mballondirɗon mbuytinɗon min e ɓunndu,
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Suka gorko wi'i wallay yo kanyum.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Waandu men ittowi ndiyam wari hokki o,
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: o yari faa o ɗomɗiti de yehi hollowi o feto.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: o tawi waandu waddanii o nareeri faa heewi.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: o nyaami de o heddii o yooɓii.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Waandu wi'i a walliino kam mi wuytoke e ɓunndu,
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: ɗum wonnoo ko mbaawum yoɓude fadde.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Wi'i wanaa aan e bammaa mbuytinnoo kam e ɓunndu?
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Tawi gusuuru na ronndinoo bootooji kanŋe e cardi ko wujjoynoo nder kiɓeeje kinɗe.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: O adi bootooji ɗi fu o kokki suka gorko.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: O wi'i yo moƴƴere hinnde nde o yoɓɓiri.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: O wari o naati nder wuro.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: O yottii dammbugal ɓaade goɗɗo o salmini.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: suka gorko e bammum mbuytinnoo e ɓunndu.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Ɓe kiirtodinoo ni ɓe puɗɗi hiiro.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Haala waddi haala ni beero haalani jom ɓaade ko waandu e gusuuru ngaɗani ɗum.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: O wi'i na o haaja jom ɓaade walla o,
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: o sotta kanŋe mo gusuuru hokkori o,
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Jom ɓaade wi'i ɗuum walaa basi.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Jam finii ni heɓanan o coodooɓe kanŋe e coodooɓe cardi.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Jom ɓaade naati ley suudu jooɗii.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: O jooɗii o heɗii heɓa fina.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Tawi gorko men na joodii na heɗii ɗum.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Gujjo kanŋe e cardi woni wuro am to na fukkii.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Bootooji ɗiɗi kanŋe e bootooru cardi wootoru o jogii.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Saboo mi yi'ay fu ko o waɗa ndi.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: so kanŋe e cardi o hebbini bootooji ni o gujjo.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Kaananke itti nilaangal dillani suka gorko.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: O haɓɓaa gaɗa kohoogol hoggo na'i na o uuma toon.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Faamunoo na o uumma ni ɗakkii heɓa humpitoo.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Nde wootere ni yurmeende naati o.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: "Aan giɗo Alla mbuytinnooɗo min e ɓunndu o,
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Tagaaɗo mo tawdanoɗaa e ɓunndu o,
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Mboddi wi'i ta o mettina ko so Alla jaɓii o ittan ɓeernde.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Mboddi itti roosi hokki o de wi'i yahan ŋatowa ɓii kaananke.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: yo wubbiran gite yo wubbiran noppi.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Nilaaɗe heɓa roosi waddowee lalli e ladde.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Nde kaɓɓaaɗo men yi'unoo nilaaɗo gooto na yaha fu,
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: O wi'i kaananke haalanee koo na o jogii roosi lobbi.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Itti nilangal wari haɓɓiti o waddi.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: O yottinoo o tiimi ɓii kaananke ni o hucciti kaananke.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: O wi'i ɗum na o jogii roosi de ɓii-ɓeernde naafiki hawrondintee.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: O wi'i beero mo o jippanii de waɗi o haɓɓaa o yo naafiki.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Ni naafiki-men haɓɓaa faa ŋeeti de hirsaa.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Ɓii-ɓeerndem itaa hawrondinaa e roosi hokkaa ɓii kaananke yari.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Ɓotti jawdi faa heewi hokkori o.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: so a yoɓay ɗum moƴƴere lobbere du,
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: tinna ta njoɓɓaa ɗum ko boni.
title: 5 Moƴƴere ɓii-aadama

text: Nyannde gom goppeere yehi ɗo naange hiirowi.
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: naange wi'i o nyamndoo ɗum buuɗi faa heewa.
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: Wari goppeere anndaa fu no watta.
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: Nyannde gom o nyalli wuro naange na o heɗii.
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: Ɗo o ummii na o hoota ɗo,
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: Goppeere fillanii ndontoori ko naange waɗi ɗum.
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: So na a haajaa biltaade na woodi ko ngaɗata."
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: Goppeere ƴami ko jey waɗude heɓa hewta nyamaandem.
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: Nde goppeere nanunoo ndontoori na dogga fu,
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: O yottinoo wuro naange ni o tawi na ɗum heɓinoo heɓa ɗum wuytoo.
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: Goppeere wi'i naange yeeƴo heɓa ɓoy mbiltondira de ɗum sakitoo ɗum yaha ɗo ɗum yahata fu.
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: Naange ƴami goppeere moy holli ɗum wara wakkati mo wari o.
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: mi taƴor so wanaa goɗɗo holli ma,
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: a waawaa anndude wakkati moy tawetee-mi wuro.
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: a hollay kam innde joomum a hewtataa nyamaande maa."
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: dagu no taƴori koo mburɗo yo maayan nih,
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: Heddii goppeere huli ta waasa buuɗim.
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: Kam holli kam wakkati ummotoo-mi so na mi yiɗi tawde ma wuro."
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: Naange wi'i goppeere hoota ko o yoɓɓirii ɗum nyamaande nde,
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: Ko ndontoori rimi e ko taani fu,
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: Annoo laawol ni yi'i cofal e coppim na njaada.
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: Nde wootere ni goppeere men mojii,
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: holli ɗi adunaaru de sakitii taaɓodii ɗi.
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: Ndelle paamee koo ko goppeere anta coppi ɗum,
title: 20 Goppeere, ndontoori e

text: Waɗiino gorko gooɗom na wi'ee ngel ɓoggi.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Jilla mo famɗi inniiko e baabiiko maayi mboppidi o naggel gootel e baalel gootel.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Nyannde gom mawɓe wuro kawriti kaalani o koo yimɓe ɗiɗo na ndewannoo baabiiko nyamaande.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Gooto maɓɓe wari haɓɓiti naggel acci mo wulla;
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: ɗiɗaɓo oo du nili ko na wara fa jaɓa baalel.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Baalel duroy tan fowru nyaami ɗum jilla o waray.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: O waroy o wi'i no suka watta fu walla yoɓa o mbaalu makko.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Mawɓe wuro taƴa ni cukalel sarɗi.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Gorel manngel na woni ley wuro ngon na wi'ee ngel ɓoggi saabu boggi watta na sonna ko na wuuri.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Ngel boggi walaa fu gooto si wanaa Alla.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: a walaa gootum mi walaa gootum.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: aɗa walla kam e golle am,
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Na hasii a heɓan njoɓiraa nyamaande ma seeɗa seeɗa."
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: suka gorko du noddiraa ngel ɓoggi.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Tawi na ɓuri rewɓe wuro fu wooɗude.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Sukaaɓe wuro fu mbanyi mo jon kay.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Ɓe ndarii faa ɓe kaɗi ɓoggi makko soodeede.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Noy o watta ko o wuura?
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: O nyobbi ɓernde makko o waɗi ko o miilayno mo waɗa.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Si o dawii ni o nanngowa liƴƴi,
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: o suuɗoo o sonnowa ɗi gere,
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Mbi'eteengel ngel ɓoggi gollitiri non hakke jeɗɗiire tan jemma gom o hoyɗi inniiko e baabiiko ngari kaaldi o,
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: mbi'i o si o nanngii liƴƴi fu ta o suuɗoo gadin;
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: o acca faa futuro dey o seeka deedi majji,
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: o wurtina ko o tawi ler ton dey,
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: O nyalli mo darii gere ndiyam o nanngey fay liingu faa naange ɓadii saamude.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Nde o warnoo fa o dilla fu,
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: liingu ceekaangu fu ɓooɗe kanŋe tawetee ler reedum.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Nde weetuno fu ngel ɓoggi adi ɓoddere wooteere holloy bahillo.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Bahillo wi'i mo ɗum wiitee kanŋe,
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: O sonnani bahillo ɓoddere nden kay.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Deekiiko hooƴi keddiiɗe resi ler tummbude doobu.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Nyannde gom goɗɗo nili sukaaɓe ngara cooda doobu ɗo maɓɓe.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Ngel ɓoggi anndaa toy deekum resannoo kanŋe.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: O taykake tummbude nde walaa haaju na wondi doobu.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Ɓe anndaa toy sukaaɓe njeyaa sakko ɓe piloo ɓoy.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: ngel ɓoggi naati na resa kanŋem ler lefol mum.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Nyannde gom o soodoy tew mo warta tan silgaare weeyi dow makko fa teeta tew.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Liƴƴi ɗi o nanngi fu tawdataake kanŋe gadin.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Ɓe njooɗorii non faa waɗi duuɓi,
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Jemma gom ngel ɓoggi hoyɗi gadin.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: baabiiko e gorel mangel ngel o wonndunoo,
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: nyannde o rimi fu min mballete nanngaa liingu ngootu;
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: na hasii gaɗa maggu a nanngataa liƴƴi gadin."
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: o tawi ɓoddere kanŋe luulu mawnde sanne.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: ɓe nji'i suudu maɓɓe na yaayni faa nanndi e nyalooma.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Jilla subaka koddo maɓɓe wari dukani ɓe,
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: wi'i ɓe kaɗii beerom ɗaanagol hankin.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: si jemma warii fu njaayri ɗum watta ley suudu."
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Jilla jamaanu nulaaɗo maama am gooto suuɗi jawdi amin ler maayo.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Liingu moɗu ngu ɓoddere luulu holli mo resiran nde duuɓi keme joy dey sakitoo hokkita mo;
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: ngu holli mo si ngu warii heɓa ngu waata fu,
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: ɗum baabiiko hoyɗi ko ummini mo fa o wara o sootta luulu maɓɓe."
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Aarabbo hokku mo ceede ɗe o waawaa limude.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: O danyi faa o ɓuri wuro fu.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Na'i makko keewi faa anndaaka noy poti.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Nyannde gom o soodi nokkure ley ladde faa o waɗa hoggo na'i.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Na o haccoo goɗɗum na rawna dow lekki;
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: o nili sukaaɓe ndaarowa ko ɗum laati;
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: tawi lefol makko ngol silgaare peesinoo ngol.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: O fiirti lefol o tawi kanŋe makko no o resirnoo.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: O warti ɓaade makko o tawi njawdiri baali ndi,
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: deekiiko naati wuro na filoo doobu.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Debbo gom miccitii soodiino doobu to makko dey wartiray tummbude;
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: o tawi nde heddodii doobu seeɗa;
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: o watti junngo makko o tawi kanŋe makko dagu no o resirnoo ɗum nih.
title: 21 Ngel ɓoggi

text: Waɗiino e leydi gooɗom ɓii-amiiru na wi'ee Sammbo.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Sammbo na laatii jokolle lobbo dey kulol haɗata ɗum ɗo daroo:
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: ɗuum waɗi ko banndiraaɓe makko noddiri mo Sambo kulol.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Waɗataa jeɗɗiire maa lewru tawee tubal fiyaaka.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Jokolle fu na anndi ko jey gollude so tubal fiyaama.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Mono fu doggantaana labbo maa takubaahi maa wawaade.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Yimɓe fu tawondira gaɗa wuro sabu nanuɗo tubal fu na anndi maa wuro honetee maa kono oorata.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Sammbo men kay nde nani tubal fu,
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: suddoo gude ni na saja kulol.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Nyanndem kay non o fukkortoo faa naange saama.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Inniiko e baakiiko fu na anndi semteende du warii sabu ɓii-amiiru so rewii faa dewlii fu,
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Suka debbo ƴamaaɗo laato dey Sammbo fu jaabo:
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: kam tan wi'i Sammbo tan heɗinoo,
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Aysatu na miila ke Sammbo waylake,
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: na laamni ke Sammbo Suusataa doggute yeesom so tubal fiyaama.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Ɗo o fuɗɗi fummugol ɗon tubal fiyaa.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: o naati suudu fa o ndaara noy goriiko lalindortoo fa naatowa konu.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: O tawi Sammbo kay waɗii ko woowno.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: O memi fa Sammbo ummoo ni o ronnki.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: O tawi nakkan nakkataa ni o taaditii gudde makko,
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: o hooƴi takubaahi muuɗum e wawaade muuɗum.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: O deki kirke dow puccu muuɗum,
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: o suddi yeeso makko tekkere ta gere makko annditee,
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Aysatu artii yimɓe fu hawrude honooɓe wuro.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Sammbo artake yimɓe fu e konu!
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Ndaaree no e taƴirta ko'e yimɓe!
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Illa naange saamay ni Aysatu e walliiɓem ndiiwi honooɓe.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Jooɗorii non faa konuuji tati mbittii fu Aysatu na waɗa no waɗannoo.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Sammbo du na waɗa ko woowunoo.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Yimɓe fu laamni ke Sammbo nattii worɓe,
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Amiiru du siinii say itta kumpa muuɗum nyannde konu nayaɓu waɗowi.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Nde honooɓe kippinoo wuro faa ndiiwaa fu,
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: amiiru hewtii mbi'aaɗo kam won Sammbo,
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: wi'i sudditan hoore makko fa anndita mo.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: O difii tan laɓi ɗeeɗi mo busal.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: O ŋeccii puccu makko doggi wartiri mo ɓaade.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: si kono waɗii fu njiitaa no ngaɗɗaa;
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Aysatu naati e sawrugol busal mum.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Ni Aysatu e Sammbo na ngondi.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Ɓuray nyalaaɗe tati ni konu ummii.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: watti takubaahi e wawaade e junngo makko,
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Ɓe anndaa ke Sammbo kay nanntaa ko ɓe mbi'ata.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Sammbo ŋaɗu dow puccu tan na omti hunnduko,
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Konuujo hooreejo buunyii Sammbo yawa ɗum labbo.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Alla waɗi laɓi Sammbo yuwi mo.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Jilla o yottaaki ɗum tan o saami.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Nyanndem Sammbo tan wari feccere kunu ngun fu.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Nde Sammbo hootunu ɓaadem fu salii tubal deƴƴataa.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: To ƴuuruɗaa e wuru fu Sammbo tann jammetee.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: Nde jemma warno fu amiiru noddi Sammbo,
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: yidde Sammbo waɗi faa Aysatu nafi Sammbo,
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: min du mi hebii donoo kam nyannde Alla muuyi e am.
title: 22 Sammbo kulol

text: O tawi goɗɗum na tewta ko nyaama.
title: 40 Wooɗiyel

text: O ardini goɗɗummiiru ndu o hondi.
title: 40 Wooɗiyel

text: o wi'i goɗɗummiiru ndu joodoo yaasi.
title: 40 Wooɗiyel

text: Jemma fuɗɗii jenngude faa hiraande waddaama.
title: 40 Wooɗiyel

text: Ɓe fu ɓe kawriti na ɓe kiirtoo.
title: 40 Wooɗiyel

title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: Moodibbo o waɗi tile tati ɗe fu ngaylii tile kanŋe.
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: Sahiijo jaabii wi'i tile ɗe yo tile tati.
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: tilde tataɓerde nde yo aan e sobbere nde njey."
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: Ndeen noon heɓa o ngoonɗina koo kanko adi cobbe ɗe.
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: Moodibbo-men yoppidi sahiijo tile tati ɗe fu,
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: Sahiijo jooɗii na ndaara tile kanŋe tati ɗe.
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: Kanko tan yoppidaa ɗe ɗe fu.
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: Nder ko sahiijo jooɗii ɗum yahalleeɓe ɗiɗo ngari tawi o ɗoon.
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: Ɓe njootondiri faa jootiiru yottii kaddi.
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: Sakitii noon sahiijo ɗaɓɓiɓe ɓe ndaarana ɗum tilem kanŋe heɓa ɗum yaha wuro ɓadiingo ngo ɗum tewtowa neema de ɗum wara.
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: Yahalleeɓe ɓe mbi'i ɗuum walaa basi so tawii o ɓooyoytaa wuro toon.
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: kanaa ɓe tappa ɗum faa fewa,
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: de ɓe ada kanŋe ɓe konda.
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: Tawi hakkillo bonngo dagu ngool sahiijo du jogii ley ɓeerndem.
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: Na o miiloo soodude ko warata yahalleeɓe,
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: o watta nyaamdu o hokkowa ɓe ɓe nyaama heɓa ɓe maaya.
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: Noon watta de o ittataa kanŋe o,
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: Sahiijo soodi nyaamdu nyaami faa haari de soodi ko wardoyta ndeenan ɓe ɗum tilem kanŋe,
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: O ronndii bone oon heɓa o hokkowa ɓe.
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

text: Ɓe tappi o faa o maayi de ɓe mbi'i ɓe nyaaman fadde maɓɓe e yeɗondirde tile maɓɓe tati kanŋe.
title: 58 Moodibbo e Saahiijom

title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: O miilii koo na o heƴi hoore makko.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Nyaande gom debbo-men ummii dawri ko tiiɗi dawrude.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: O wi'i o wuytoto wuro o hoota ladde.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Nde o warnoo heɓa o dilla,
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: o faamini wurooɓe makko ko o yiɗaa goɗɗo wara weerana o.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: So wanaa mbe'eewa fu yo mbaala,
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: so wanaa ngeelooba fu yo nagge ardondiri.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: O limi lebbi faa duuɓi keewi.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Wari o tawi koo o waawaa wuurude kanko tan.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Kanko mbi'unooɗo koo ngaruɗo weerani o fu yo eelgal jawdi makko waddi ɗum,
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Ɓuji neeji ɗi luwe ngaɗe fiyande koyngal jokolle kaarɗo cennditii pukkii lettugal suudu makko.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: ɗi ɓiɓɓe muɓɓoy keddii na koonta kanndi ommbi soɓɓiire e horɗoore suudu,
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Debbo o naati hakkunde na'im na waancoo.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: O yoppi o wi'i yettoore Alla,
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Ɓe njootondiri faa jootiiru yottii ɗo waawi yottaade.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: O ummii o ɗooti ɗum faa wurtowii hoggo makko.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Nde debbo o yeeƴitinoo suudum fu,
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Ɗi mbi'i joomiiji ko ɗi kaajaakanaa ɗi kaalana ɗum koo ɓeero o wanaa ɓii aadama remmbe.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Heddii ɓe kiirdi ɗoon faa jenngi.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: jawdi ndi watti itti nilaaɓe njehi to joomii ɓoy.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: "No min njiɗiri ma de min ngari heɓa min kaalane,
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: heɓa o itta hoore maa o yaarana tooruure jinnaaji mawɗi.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Kanko e hoore makko o jinnaaru."
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Jawdi ndi haalunoo yottini ni debbo men ɓeerni.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Heddii nde jemma hiiri fu gorko o waran hiiro.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: yo hollan debbo o ko woni.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Nih faa ɗo debbo o waridi jawdi ndi.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Saboo o miilataakonaa jawdi ndi haajaakanaa senndude o e gorko o.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Ni gorko men heddii na wara.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: So muuyii wadde debbo o ko boni ni suudu faddoo bone oon.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Suudu ndu warowi wi'i o reentoo e gorko o.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Debbo le anndaa koo suudu ndu yo bone faddantoo ɗum.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: O sikkaanaa suudu ndu yo hiran o.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Heddii nyannde gom o duppi ndu de o hoɗanowi kollangal.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Naange saamunoo gadi ni naa gorko men na wara.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: E ɓeerndem na miiloo koo nyanndem kay,
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: O rewnoo faa o doomi ni,
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: "Noy de na a woni ɗo hannde ?"
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: jaabii wi'i koo ɗum wulu suudum,
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: saboo suudu ndu yo hiran ɗum.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Ɗo wari heɓa wara debbo o,
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Debbo o annditay koo kollangal ngal yo bone faddanii ɗum.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: O wi'i o rewan beero makko o hoota wurom saboo yimɓe ɓe yo keewu kiram.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: So na a haajaa ni njahaa ɗo njawɗaa fu.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Jonnoon na leeɓi paamaa ko fay gooto hirataama.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Mono fu yo bone mo a yi'ataa o,
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: yi'ata de na haajaa wallude ma."
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Heddii jinnaaru ndu wi'i o taaɓoo ɓe njaha de o yoppira kollangal ngal dagu no Alla yoppiri ngal nih.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: gorko o hollitii koo wanaa tomotte.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Heddii ndu taƴi hoore debbo o.
title: 59 Debbo Kiroowo

text: Golleeji ɓaade fu yo kanko gollata.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Ɗo o gollata ɗo fu yo yidde e saabu Alla.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Wari nyannde gom debbo o fini,
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: o tawi o liɓanaama haɓɓere leɗɗe,
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: o tawi gollal ngal o woowunoo gollude,
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Gollal ngal o yoppi fu o warta o tawa gollaamaa.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Heddii o yehi to moodibbo heɓa o faamitowoo ko woni.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: o tewta hoore junngo o hokka ɗum ko so Alla jaɓii o faaman ko woni.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Debbo men itti fiyaarem honndu hokki.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Moodibbo jaɓii fiyaare loowi de wi'i:
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: So Alla jaɓii a heɓan anndude moy gollante golleeji ɗi e dullaangal maa."
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Na o yaha faa o wari o yi'i kaareehi makki.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: O seli o yehi kaareehi toon.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: O yottinoo ki ni o itti hakkilowol o muɗɗii.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: dagu no moodibbo o wi'iri ni.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: O tawi hakkilowol ngol yo welu.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: O wi'i so hakko welii ni tawete heccere ɓuri welde.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: O itti haareere heccere o ƴakki.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: O tawi haareere nde ɓuri welde.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Ni o tewti haareere ɓenndunde o ƴakki.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: O adi yuunuure haareere nde o hondi o wattowi e wadarde makko.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Oon ɓii-aadma gollannoo golleeji makko ɗi.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: tawaa yerum e wodde e jaɓude ko wi'aa walaa.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Faamu ko na o jogii mboɗa.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: So Alla jaɓii o yaataa ɗo baaniye woni.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Debbo o laɓi ɓiyum oon Jiija.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Jiija tawaa ɗo innam faa surbinɗini.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Walaa fu ɗo haala wodde makko haalataake.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: O itti nilangal yehi to inna Jiija ɗaɓanowa o Jiija.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Nde nilangal kaananke hewtunoo inna Jiija ni ɗum wi'i:
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: "Na mi famɗi heɓa wi'ee mi salanoke kaananke moƴƴere.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Ndelle na mi daɓɓa on so Alla waɗii on kootii mballon kam kaananke faama koo so na yiɗi Jiija ni yo kam jey Jiija.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: O watta o faama koo jiija na jogii mboɗa:
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: O soggitaa o hooti wuro kaananke.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Dagu maggo yi'aaka illa aduna jooɗii.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Ndeen noon kaananke sakiti hawrondini yimɓem,
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: O wi'i du njedduɗo mboɗa o fu,
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Walaa ɗo yimɓe ƴuurataa na ngara na ndaara ŋari makko.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Nyannde gom kaananke wi'i gaɗa yimɓe na ngarda wurom saabu ŋari Jiija ni gure de fu kaalanee koo kawrital na woodi wuro maɓɓe ɗoon.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Kaajaaɗo yi'ude Jiija fu wara nyaanndem saboo gaɗa ndeen nyalaande o accata yimɓe na naatira ɓaade makko no kaajoraa taadu koo Jiija kaajaa yi'ude.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Kaananke waɗi nyaamduuji feere feereeji ndefanaa werɓe.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Yimɓe ƴamondiri moy hoorata mayde Jiija.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Wi'aa kooroowo mayde Jiija na tiiɗi saboo Jiija,
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Kaanaan heddii wi'i hooran nilangal ngal.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Heddii kaanaan yehi wuro inna Jiija.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: na ngal fiiltoo suudu inna Jiija.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: O yi'unoo kaana ni o annditi.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Jahaangal ittaa yehi wuro kaananke ƴamtinowii.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Inna Jiija wi'i na anndunoo tiiri.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Debbo waɗanay nawlum mboɗa e bada.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: So keɓii laawol fu na mbarondir.
title: 60 Jiija e nawliraaɓem

text: Njannde gom bojel wi'i njuuraa ɓe tewta no ɓe ngaɗi koo naangere maɓɓe woɗɗoke.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: ndaari nano e nyaamo de wi'i bojel:
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: "E miilo am walaa no ngaɗen ta naangere nde wara en so wanaa inniraaɓe men cottuɗen."
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: heɓa so weeti ɓe nanna inniraaɓe maɓɓe luumo.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Weetunoo ni mono fu waddi innam.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Njuuraa haɓɓiri innam raande lobbere tekkunde nde hawilawaaka.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: ni bojel yoppa ɓoccoonde wootere fotta de wi'a:
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: inna am muuyi teetaade de piw-mi ɗum."
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Ni njuuraa du ada sawru fiya innam de wi'a ɗum,
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: mi jaynete nih so a muuyii ta'nyude.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Ba waɗan seeɗa ni bojel halɓi.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: "A yi'ay ko inna am teetii ɗum."
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: "Hulu Alla de celaa bojji maa ɗi.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Gaɗa inna am ta'nyay ni baasi walaa.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: So en cottii ɗum ni danyan ko sukkani en."
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Be ndewondiri faa ɓe naati e luumo.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Ɓe cotti inna njuuraa ɓe coodi daandi.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Kiikiiɗe warnoo ni njuuraa e bojel adi laawol wuro muɓɓoy.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: ɓe njehii ni bojel wi'a selan.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Njuuraa yottoken tawii wojere na waalii ni tiima,
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Wari njuuraa darii miilii de wi'itii ko so suɓanno boje ɗe yi'i na mbaati dow laawol ɗe,
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: ni heƴƴiino ko hebbina bootooru honda.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Ɓe adi laawol na ɓe njaha.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Ɗum selunoo ni njuuraa haɓɓi daandi de yeeƴanii boje ɗe yi'unoo dow laawol.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: O nanngi daandi ndi o hirsi,
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: o adi teewu mayri o mooɓoy de o adi lacol o ufi e honndorde faa yoolii,
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Ba ɓooyal ni njuuraa warti na ɓalinii.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: "Won ko o yeeƴaninoo de o tawoway.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Ni njuuro ummanii ɗo haɓɓunoo daandim.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Nde wootere ni bojel yoppi wi'i:
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: war ndar honndorde moɗii daandi maa yoppi laccol yaasi.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Bojel wi'i ta o waɗanoo so wanaa o haaja lacol ngool taƴa.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Ɓe tefoy gollitirɗi ɓe ngari ɓe puɗɗi wasude.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Oo wasii somii ni oo to jaɓa.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Manngal ladde warowi tawi ɓe ɗoon.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Walaa fu ko miilotoo e ɓeerndem so wanaa dogga taƴa luulotooɗe manngal ladde doggida.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Njuuraa ndaari luulotooɗe mannngal ladde faa ɓooyi.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: So ɗe luuloroke nano ni njuuro luuloroo nano.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: So ɗe luuloroke nyaamo ni njuuro luuloroo nyaamo.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Nih faa ɗo njuuro yoppi wi'i e ɓeerdem:
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: wasa uuta nyaamdu de nani nyaamdu na luuloo;
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: ɗume ngaɗam mi ndi daandi so mi heɓii ɗee luulotooɗe ?"
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Jaka ko njuuraa miilotoo e ɓeerndem teetoke wuytoke yaasi faa bojel nanii.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Njuuraa wi'i miilataakonaa leeɓaa jooɗoo de mawɗo ladde na wasa.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Manngal ladde jaabii wi'i ɗuum walaa baasi.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Ba waɗan seeɗa ni njuuraa wi'i e ɓeerndem:
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: "So neɗɗo heɓii ɗe luulotooɗe ni walaa ko waɗa ndi ufiindi."
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Njuuro wi'i a nanii ko miilotoo-mi ɗum!
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Ni bojel haɓɓiti bootoorum itti pemmborki hokki.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Ni bojel watti ƴamtinii ko o haajaa.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Njuuro jaabii wi'i yo bootooru ɗaɓi.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Ni manngal ladde na heddii na wasa.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Ba maƴƴere ni taƴi luulotooɗe manngal ladde watti e bootoorum de itti gullal.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Manngal ladde boɓɓii na ɓoyloo naawu e dukkuru.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Bojel naatondiri e sawrinde manngal ladde.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: ɗum fewna ɓeerdem ko so Alla jaɓii ni njuuraa heɓete.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Manngal ladde wi'i so njuuraa heɓaaka ni bojel hirsete.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Bojel heɓunoo seedi e manngal ladde ni miilii no jey waarude.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: O nili adunaaru fu haalanaa koo hiiro manngo woodi.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Nilaaɗo yottinoo wuro njuuraa ni ƴami salle njuuraa na ɗoon.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Tawi njuuraa faa logologo suudu wonnoo.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: "Moy mo Alla haɗi wodde wi'i koo min njuuro mi maayii.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Yoppi dey njuuro darii na semti.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Njuuro naati ley suudu adi hoddum de dillani hiiro.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Njuuro yottinoo ni nannowaa nder danki.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Teewu na tibii faa ɓuri jonndem toowude.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Guri be'i e baali na luuloo.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: ni heenta teewu faɗɗa e hunnduko.
title: 6 Njuuraa e luulotooɗe

text: Njuuraa ƴakki teewu faa tilde ɓuytii.

title: 4 Fowru e Noora

title: 4 Fowru e Noora

title: 4 Fowru e Noora

title: 4 Fowru e Noora

title: 4 Fowru e Noora

title: 4 Fowru e Noora

title: 4 Fowru e Noora

title: 4 Fowru e Noora

text: Ɗuum won ɗo o gollunoo Noora golle bonɗo to.

title: Sammbo cuusu

text: Sukka debbo makko du na wonii e ngendi mboɗɗundi.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: Wari nyande gomma kanko e koddo makko ɓe njaadi toon.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: Be njaanoo fu ɓe tawi sukka debbo o, luumo wuro mumɓoy.

text: O wi'i sukka debbo o, hanndee kaa na mi yiɗɗi njiiden.

title: Sammbo cuusu

text: O wi'i gorgal wuro muɓoy ɓokki makki woni ɗoon na wondi e luuro; ɓe kawran ɗoon.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: Nde rewnoo faa jenngi seeɗaa fu, ƴoonde nangi nano nangi nyaamo, toɓi kaddi ko waawi fu.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: Wawtu oon, nokku yo heewu dawaaɗi ladde.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: Sukka debbo oon du wari yehi toon, ɓokki toon.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: O wari o naati ley luuro ɓokki toon imo doomi sukka gorko oon.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: Jakka ladeeru rimmi ley luuro ɓokki ɗoon.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: O lutti bogo gooto na o jooɗii.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: Laddeeru nduu du, ko rimi ɗum, ɓiɓɓem nyaamataa fu goɗɗum so wanaa teewu ɓii-Aadama.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: Laddeeru wari warti waancule muuɗum tawi imo jooɗii ɗoon.

text: Laddeeru ƴami ɗume foti wannude ma nih.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: O wi'i so ngoongaa ni hakkunde makko e yigoo; amaanu ɓe ngaddunoo faa ɓe kawra ɗo dey, ɗuum waddi kam dey mi yi'ay ɗum tay.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: O holli ɗum inde ngendi ndiin.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: Laddeeru ndu wi'i gaɗa ni a bonnay aadi a waɗɗii o ammaanu ni en andan aadi.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: So ni a yehi, welo-welo hakkunde maa e gorko waɗowi a haali ke miin addi ma waddi fu, dow ɗo kaalataa ɗoon maayataa.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: Nokku fu ɗo uffowaɗaa mi waran mi utee mi hokke ɓiɓɓe am.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: O wi'i ndelle o bonnataa aadi ammaanu.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: Joggii o faa ɓe camndii suudu sukka goorko; o heddii o fitti o tirgitii o naati suudu sukka gorko.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: O ƴami o, noy ni ngaɗɗaa dey warɗaa ɗo, koyɗe maa ngaɗay looppe.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: Sukka gorko wi'i joonin kaa a jammbi kam.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: O wi'i ammaanu hakkude men o, mi haalante, ɗum minnyantaa kam jam.
title: Sammbo cuusu

text: Laddeeru addi kam waddi dey ndu wi'aanaa so mi haali fu, ɗum minnyantaa kam jam.
title: Sammbo cuusu

title: Sammbo cuusu

title: Sammbo cuusu

text: Soni so Alla waray, kaananke warataa!

text: Kaanankee ƴammi: "Noy ngaɗɗaa dey kewtuɗaa fiyaare nde ?

title: Soni so Alla waray, kaana

text: Ko mbi'aataa ko so Alla waray ni kaananke warataa ɗum wellaa kam; ɗuum saabii.
title: Soni so Alla waray, kaana

text: Ndelle, nde ni nde faɗɗowanoo, liinga moɗi nde.

text: Awotooɗo o, nde awowinoo fu heɓi liinga ngaa wari sottiri kam.

text: Kuttum liinga ngaan dey tawum fiyaare ndeen ley reedu magga.
