text: Wari yi'i sukaaɓe ɗiɗo, ƴami ɗum en, wi'i: "Sukaaɓe yalla wanaa onon kooƴi ɓoccokoy am na ?"
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Buugalel wi'i on penii, gooto mon ni hooƴi.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Ɓe fu ɓe mbi'i ɓe kooƴaay.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Buugalel wi'i ndelle si on kooƴaay fu, min ya mi yiitan kooƴuɗo.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Ngaree mi holla on; ngaree mi yaara on to ɓunndu, penɗo fu faamete.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Sukaaɓe ɓeen ndu tokki wuugaandu faa njottii nokkuure gooɗom.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Tawi ɓunndu ɓoldu, ndiyam fu walaa ton.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Nde naatunoo fu, o wi'i ɗum wi'a:
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Si ni min hooƴi ɓoccokoy taarabiinndiƁunndu ɓulooru ɓula kam faa e daandePooloy biidi nyaama kam faa ta keddu.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: tan suka on naati, darii ley ɓunndu ton, wi'i:
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Si ni min hooƴi ɓoccokoy taarabiinndiƁunndu ɓulooru ɓula kam faa e daandePooloy biidi nyaama kam faa ta keddu.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Wuugaandu na won dow lekki na ndaara.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Si ni min hooƴi ɓoccokoy taarabiinndiƁunndu ɓulooru ɓula kam faa e daandePooloy biidi nyaama kam faa ta keddu.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: O wi'i non gati; ni huunde fu waɗaay, tan wungaandu wi'i o wurtoo.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Gaɗa oo to wurtoke ni wi'aa ɗiɗaɓo o, naata.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Oon du naati; o wi'i ɗum wi'a non.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Si ni min hooƴi ɓoccokoy taarabiinndiƁunndu ɓulooru ɓula kam faa e daandePooloy biidi nyaama kam faa ta keddu.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Tan ndiyam fuɗɗi na wurtoo ley ɓunndu ton faa yottii koyɗe muuɗum.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Wuugaandu wi'i o wi'a non gatin; o wi'i:
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Si ni min hooƴi ɓoccokoy taarabiinndiƁunndu ɓulooru ɓula kam faa e daandePooloy biidi nyaama kam faa ta keddu.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Suka gorko yimidinnoo fu, ndiyam wurtii ley ɓunndu ton gadin faa yottii mo koppi.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: O yiman tan ndiyam na ɓeydoo.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Na, o yima tan ndiyam na ɓeydoo fa, fa, faa ndiyam yottii mo daande.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: O yoolii tan pooloy fu, ngonnookoy ɗon, pooloy taarabiindi, ngari cuppiti mo, cuppiti mo fa, fa, faa kedday mo fay gootum.
title: Ɓoccooɗe Buugalel

text: Goɗɗo gooɗom du wiitaakena Ndotti; mo yaha fa o tawi nyaalel dow tefaare na darii.
title: Ndotti

text: Tan o wii ɗum nyaalel, foofoo!
title: Ndotti

text: A faaman ko woni piiciti pooco.
title: Ndotti

text: Tan ɗum mettimo; o yehi mbarkileehi, o siri baajel, o wari o tawi nyaalel na darii dow tefaare ton tan, o haɓɓi ɗum.
title: Ndotti

text: O haɓɓunoo nyaalel tan, mo jogii mo yaha, mo yaha faa goɗɗo hawri mo.
title: Ndotti

text: Oo ni tawi kam dow tefaare,Miɗo fitta e fittugol am, O wii kam nyaalel foofoo, Mbii-mi o piiciti pooco, piiciti pooco,Nyaale poliiɗe pooli,Jaka ɗum non ndotti ɓeerni,Siri bajel haɓɓi nyaalel,Herkiti daangel dow tefaare.
title: Ndotti

text: Ɓe njehi ɓe kawrowi goɗɗo gatin.
title: Ndotti

text: O wi'i min kay mi anndaa, ƴamee nyaalel.
title: Ndotti

text: Oo ni tawi kam dow tefaare,Miɗo fitta e fittugol am, O wii kam nyaalel foofoo, Mbii-mi o piiciti pooco, piiciti pooco,Nyaale poliiɗe pooli,Jaka ɗum non ndotti ɓeerni,Siri bajel haɓɓi nyaalel,Herkiti daangel dow tefaare.
title: Ndotti

text: Faa ɓe njehi nokkuure gooɗom, nyaale na keewi sanne, kurmiti ɓe, mbi'i nyaalel koreei jam?
title: Ndotti

text: Oo ni tawi kam dow tefaare,Miɗo fitta e fittugol am, O wii kam nyaalel foofoo, Mbii-mi o piiciti pooco, piiciti pooco,Nyaale poliiɗe pooli,Jaka ɗum non ndotti ɓeerni,Siri bajel haɓɓi nyaalel,Herkiti daangel dow tefaare.
title: Ndotti

text: Tan nyaale kurmiti Ndotti, kam en du, coppi ɗum ni, coppi ɗum ni, coppi ɗum ni fa, fa, faa ndotti du waati.
title: Ndotti

text: Puccu gooɗom na woni ley wuro na wi'ee Jamalenngu.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Joomiraaɓe puccu ɓen na njogii cukalel.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Suka on mawni dey koreeji muuɗum en na mbi'a ɗum wawtu fu tinnoo e puccu ngun, sabu na yiɗi puccu sanne.
title: Jamalenngu

text: O tinnoo taa o waɗɗoo puccu ngun.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Kanko le pucci ɗi o waɗɗotoo ɗi fu, ngu koreeji makko kaɗɗi o ngun tan o horannta.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Koreeji makko le fu, na kakkilani ngu, na anndi ngu wooɗaa.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Nyannde gom le koreeji makko fay gooto walaa ɗon.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Kanko du o wi'i o ndaaran ko saabi ko ɓen mbi'i ta o waɗɗoo puccu ngun.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Tan o fiirti puccu o waɗɗii.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Nde o waɗɗinoo ɗum ko o wurtii fu jogi na doggida mo, na doggida mo, na doggida mo fa, fa, faa o anndaa fu to o woni ?
title: Jamalenngu

text: O tefi ooncude ɗum fa o warta wuro.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Si wanaa o yehi fa, fa, faa wuro gooɗom, o anndaa fu ton.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Nde o yottinoo fu yimɓe ɓen njottii kurmiti mo.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Mo yottoo, ɓen na nannga mo; nanngunoo mo fu, ngatti ley suudu coki, ommbi.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Nde kaɓɓunoo puccu ngun yaasin fu, kanko kay ommbi mo ley suudu, kalfini mo dem-mawɗo.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Kalfinnoo mo dem-mawɗo fu, mbi'i fa njaha jon kay pilowoo leɗɗe, fa ngara njuɗa mo.
title: Jamalenngu

text: O faamii kanko du ko ɓen sukunyaaɓe.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Ngattunoo mo ley suudu kalfini dem-mawɗo fu, kaɓɓi puccu makko yaasin, dem-mawɗo na jooɗii dammbugal.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Nde sukunyaaɓe ɓe ndillunoo njehi fa pilowoo jon kay leɗɗe ngara fa njuɗa mo nyaama fu, dem-mawɗo on wi'i: "Suka, ko foti waddude ma ɗo ?"
title: Jamalenngu

text: Ɗum ni inna am wiinoo kamƊum ni baaba am wiinoo kamTa mi waɗɗoo jamalennguJamalenngu doggi dartaakoSay say dammbugal sukunyaaɓe.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Ɗum ni inna am wiinoo kamƊum ni baaba am wiinoo kamTa mi waɗɗoo jamalennguJamalenngu doggi dartaakoSay say dammbugal sukunyaaɓe.
title: Jamalenngu

text: O wi'i, demmawɗo accu ndelle mi wurtoo yaasin kay mi ndaara puccu am, sabu nyaamaay.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Ɗum ni inna am wiinoo kamƊum ni baaba am wiinoo kamTa mi waɗɗoo jamalennguJamalenngu doggi dartaakoSay say dammbugal sukunyaaɓe.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Dem-mawɗo wi'i wallay a wonnii, dey noy mbiiɗa gatin ?
title: Jamalenngu

text: o wi'i accu ndelle mi huumta puccu am ngu mi yarnowaa ɗum sabu yaraay ndiyam.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Debbo mawɗo wi'i hey suka, a doggataa na ?
title: Jamalenngu

text: Fay si njaa-mi ɗo mi wartan.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Nde o haɓɓitainnoo fu, dem-mawɗo wi'i o yima ginan.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Ɗum ni inna am wiinoo kamƊum ni baaba am wiinoo kamTa mi waɗɗoo jamalennguJamalenngu doggi dartaakoSay say dammbugal sukunyaaɓe.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Nde o waɗɗinoo fu, o fiyi puccu makko, nanaa na yaha; o heɓi o oonci ɗum jon kay yaade wuro.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Dem-mawɗo doomi faa sawti yi'aay, anndaa fu no watta.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Tan yehi ndaarowi nokkuwel nyaande to yimɓe cokkata na ƴaroo.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Dem-mawɗo yehi, ley nyaande suuɗowi jon kay sabu na anndi sukanyaaɓe ngartii fu mbaran ɗum.
title: Jamalenngu

text: O yehi ley nyaande o uwowii ton.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Sukunyaaɓe ngartunoo fu, ndaari: tawaay puccu, tawaay jom puccu.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Tawi wuugaandu warii fa filoo gabbe, na soppa.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Na sankitannoo nyaande fu, tawi dem-mawɗo na irii ton, tan hoɗi dow leggal na waɗa: “Wukkutu wukkutu, wurtin dem-mawɗo ley nyaande."
title: Jamalenngu

text: Tan yimɓe mbi'i ɗum e wuugaandu ndu wiita nih?
title: Jamalenngu

text: Ɓe kettinii faa ɓooyi, ɓe nani ko wuugaandu wiita.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Ɓe njehi ɓe ndarowi ley nyannde ɓe tawi dem-mawɗo.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Kam ni yaa ɓe kooƴowi ɓe ngari ɓe luttini jom Jamalenngu, ɓe nduppi ɗum, ɓe nyaam-mi.
title: Jamalenngu

text: Waɗiino e jamaanuuji, suka tewtoowo anndal.
title: Hayndeeji

text: O wi'i walaa fu ko o yiɗi so wanaa anndude ko woni e adunaaru.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Gorko mawɗo men wi'i o yaha de o warta o fillanoo ɗum ko o yi'i.
title: Hayndeeji

text: So o waalii ɗo hannde, ni o waala to, jaango.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Walaa fu ko o hiirnii so wanaa tewtiiru anndal.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Heddii suka gorko men wari tawi hayre raneere toy na waalii.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Ni o turii heɓa o ada nde.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Ni hayre men fitti foɓii tiinde makko de fottowi yeeso.
title: Hayndeeji

text: O memi adude nde, o hunngii.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Ndeen noon o watti o wi'i, waɗii haynde nde haynaaki Alla.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Hayre men wi'i o, ɗum koo haynaaki; yaw yeeso ko a yi'an ko haynii.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Wari o hawri jabaare na dogga, na doggida kure sappo e ɗiɗi.
title: Hayndeeji

text: O wi'i ɗum waɗii ko haynii haynaaki Alla.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Noy de piɗaɗaa kure sappo e ɗiɗi, a boɓɓaaki sakko aan waatata ?
title: Hayndeeji

text: Jabaare men wi'i o, ɗum koo haynaaki; yaw yeeso ko a yi'an ko haynii.
title: Hayndeeji

text: O wari o tawi jabaare wonnde na fiɗaa kural gootal na boɓɓii, waati na waalii.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Jaka ko jabaare nde wi'unoo ɗum yo ngoonga.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Ɗum na yaadannoo kure sappo e ɗiɗi, boɓɓaaki sakko waatan, de ɗum kural gootal tan, de na waati na waalii.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Goɗɗum tawaa ɗoon, wi'i ɗum koo haynaaki.
title: Hayndeeji

text: So Alla jaɓii a yottowoke yeeso, a yi'owan ko ɓuri ɗum haynaade.
title: Hayndeeji

text: O wari o tawi gorko mawɗo mo duuɓi capanɗe jeenay na woni hakkunde sukaaɓe ɓe duuɓi sappo e sappo e ɗiɗɗiɗi.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Sukaaɓe ɓe, ƴommbe mbaɗɗii na ndoggina hano pucci ni.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Gorko nawɗo o, na jooɗii nder lekki.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Sukaaɓe ɓe, camndondira pucci ɗi nay nay e tati tati, ndoggina de ngara ndaasoo yeeso gorko mawɗo o.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Ɓe ngara ɓe njooɗoo ɗakkol gorko mawɗo.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Suka ngarɗo heɓa nyaama fu, itta lonngere wootere watta e le'al de sakitoo fuɗɗa nyaamde.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Ko woni e le'al ɗum wonnoo nyaamdu gorko mawɗo.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Haɗataa ɗum haarude, haɗataa sukaaɓe ɓe, haarude.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Gorko mawɗo men wi'i o, ɗum koo haynaaki.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Ko ɓuri ɗum haynaade na woni yeeso.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Ta termu hantude ko haynii so wanaa a hulataa tampiri.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Ko ɓuranoo kam ni kootaa wuro maa.
title: Hayndeeji

text: O yottinoo fu, o jippowii ɗo gorko mawɗo, mo o wayninoo ko o tewtowan anndal o.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Gorko mawɗo wi'i a yehii tewtiiru anndal faa a wartii.
title: Hayndeeji

text: O wi'i mi yehii faa mi warti.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Suka gorko jaabbbii o; o wi'i, hoore aranande fu, nde ndillunoo-mi, mi yi'aanaa hayre raneere toy toy.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Termum faa waɗi koyngal tati, mi waaway adude nde.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Gorko mawɗo wi'i hayre raneere toy nde, hollataanaa ibiliisa filataako ɓii-aadama remmbe.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Warowi hawri jabaare na doggida kure sappo e ɗiɗi.
title: Hayndeeji

text: O wi'i waɗii ko haynii haynaaki Alla.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Jabaare wi'i, o yaha ko o yi'an ko ɓuri ɗuum haynaade.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Gorko mawɗo wi'i jabaare nde njiwɗaa na yahada e kure sappo e ɗiɗi de waatay nde, yo ɓii-wuro.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Ɓii-wuro ko waɗi fu na munyanee faa waɗa kile sappo e ɗiɗi, de sakitee waɗee ko wattee fu.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Gorko mawɗo ƴami ko o yi'i nde o taaɓinoo.
title: Hayndeeji

text: O wi'i nde taaɓinoo-mi, jabaare nji'um na waati na waali.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Ndaarum, tawum kural gootal ngal ɓuraa fay gootum, fiɗaa de waati.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Gorko mawɗo wi'i, jabaare nde kural gootal wari nde, hollataanaa koo janano, ɗo yehi fu, nannga hoore muuɗum.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Golle gooto na waawi heddude ɗum.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Warowi tawi gorko neejo na jooɗii ley lekki; sukaaɓe, ɓe duuɓi sappo sappo e sappo e ɗiɗɗiɗi na ndoggina ƴommbe na ngara na ndaasa yeeso muuɗum.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Gorko mawɗo, ittee lonngere lonngere hokkoree.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Kam haaran, haɗataa sukaaɓe du haarude.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Gorko mawɗo wi'i, gorko mo tawɗaa ley lekki o, oon won sifa gorko annduɗo ko gollata.
title: Hayndeeji

text: So neɗɗo anndii ko gollata, no sukaaɓe ngardi e muuɗum fu, na heƴi e muuɗum.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Kaa mo anndaa fu, wi'ataanaa yo gorko jayɗo.
title: Hayndeeji

text: So mawɗo jaasay, marataa sukaaɓe, marataa mawɓe.
title: Hayndeeji

text: Suka debbo gooɗom, rimaa, faa wari mawni.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Jon le, koreeji makko fu mbanyi o.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Baabiiko du wanyi mo, hooƴi o hokki maamiiko.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Jon kay yaari o to goggiiko.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Goggiiko oon nananii jon kay goɗɗo gom na wi'ee Manna.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Jom huunde sanne, na filoo debbo.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Wooɗi neeɗo le fu yiɗaa o.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Tan goggiiko on du hooƴi o hokki Manna.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Manna waɗi yimɓe ngari kaɓani o.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Jon kay nde o ɓaŋetenoo nden, fay gooto ɗowtiraay o wuro Manna ton si wanaa korɗo makko debbo.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Joomum linndi gineeji ɓanngal, o parii faa o wooɗi.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: O waɗɗinaa puccu, korɗo debbo makko on du ronndaa kaake makko, na tokki mo, na haɓɓi godoore muuɗum.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Ɓe njaha, ɓe njaha; kam le ronndi ndiyam, kam ronndi gineeji ko nyaamdu fu; ɓe njaha, ɓe njaha, ɓe kuybi wuro Manna ton.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Fa, fa, faa naange nyawli tan tawi pullo debbo ɗomɗii.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: O wi'i korɗo:, " Mi yiɗaanaa mi yara."
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Korɗo on wi'i a yardataa nih.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Si a yiɗaanaa njara fu, ittaa misooro maaɗa kokkoraa kam mi haɓɓa.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: O tawi mo ɗomɗi sanne; o itti misooro makko o hokki korɗo debbo oon haɓɓi.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Toɓɓa ni mo ndiyam o yari.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Ɓe njaha, ɓe njaha gadin faa ɓooyi.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Tawi o yolbii, mo haaja nyaamde.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Korɗo debbo on salii, wi'i si wanaa o ɓoortoo kamsel makko o hokka ɗum.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: O ɓoortii kamsel o hokki ɗum ɓoornii, haɓɓi misooro.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Ɓe njahi gadin faa o ɗomɗi.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Korɗo debbo o wi'i fey, si wanaa o jaɓa wudere muuɗum godoore nde o taado.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Jon kay fa, fa, faa ko o haajaa fu, si wanaa o itta gineeji makko o hokka korɗo debbo on ko hokka o ko o haaja.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Godoore korɗo debbo nde tan heddii e makko.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Fadde maɓɓe yottaade gatin, tawi o muuyii yarde ndiyam.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Korɗo debbo wi'i ndelle si wanaa o jippoo o ronndoo kaake ɗen dey, ƴeenya dow puccu ɗon.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: O jippii, o ronndii kaake ɗen dey korɗo debbo ƴeenyi dow puccu.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Nde ɓe njottinoo wuro fu, koreeji Manna en njakkitii ɓe.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Wi'aa mbaɗɗiiɗo puccu o, kam wonnoo mo Manna ɓaŋi.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Kanko ɓaŋanooɗo o du, o laatii korɗo.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Nde o wartuno fu, o waɗaa korɗo.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Korɗo debbo on du, naati suudu Manna, kam woni deekum.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Jon le sini o durowii faa laasara, mo warta ni o fanta feto gooɗom mo lootoo.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: O itta gineeji makko fu mo lootoo.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Ni baali ɗin du keddoo na ndaara mo.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Baali ɗin na ndaara o fa ɓooya tan o wi'a ɗum en:
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Baali ko ndaartonBaali Manna ko ndaartonInna am wanyi kamHooƴi hokki kam baaba amBaaba am wanyi kamHooƴi hokki kam maama amMaama am wanyi kamHooƴi hokki kam goggo amGoggo am wanyi kamHooƴi hokki kamManna ko settani kam genndeeru Ko durni kam baali muuɗum.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: O lootoo, o ɓornoo gineeji makko o horra baali.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Nyannde o durowi fu, nde o wari mo lootoo fu, baali ɗin ngara gatin na ndaaramo.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Ni o yimira no o yimirnoo noon; o wi'a:
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Baali ko ndaartonBaali Manna ko ndaartonInna am wanyi kamHooƴi hokki kam baaba amBaaba am wanyi kamHooƴi hokki kam maama amMaama am wanyi kamHooƴi hokki kam goggo amGoggo am wanyi kamHooƴi hokki kamManna ko settani kam genndeeruKo durni kam baali muuɗum.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Jon le wawtu fu non faa nyannde gom jaado goriiko on, jaado Manna on, yi'i mo horra baali faa o yottii feto ngon tan, mogginii na ndaara faa o ɓoortii gineeji makko, na yi'a baali ɗin na ndaara mo.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Nde nannoo na o yima fu, wi'i wanaa meere, yehi haalanowi Manna.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: On wi'i ɗum nda, an koy duroowo baali o non woni deeka.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: O wi'i dey si a jaɓaay fu ngaraa ndaara so na mo warta.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Manna on tokki jaadom, faa laasara gadin nde o wartowannoo, ɓe mogginii, Manna e jaado muuɗum.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: O wari mo looto gadin tan baali ɗin keddii na ndaara mo; o yimi gadin o wi'i:
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Baali ko ndaartonBaali Manna ko ndaartonInna am wanyi kamHooƴi hokki kam baaba amBaaba am wanyi kamHooƴi hokki kam maama amMaama am wanyi kamHooƴi hokki kam goggo amGoggo am wanyi kamHooƴi hokki kamManna ko settani kam genndeeruKo durni kam baali muuɗum.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Manna on yiinoo ɗum fu, o hooti Jaangoore muuɗum subaka tan, Manna ɓoorti korɗo debbo on gineeji, soodani mo gineeji kesi watti ley suudu muuɗum.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Tawi ɗum ɓooyii le, waɗii dagu hitaande fadde muuɗum faamude.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Tan tawi korɗo debbo o reedii.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: O riiwaa o wattaa e durngol.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Nyannde o duroynoo fu, nyanndem o rimi.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: O rimnoo fu o huli wartude.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Jon kay o hooƴi ɓinngel makko ngel o yehi o halfinowi waande.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Jaangoorem fu, nde o yaanoo o durowi fu, faa laasara, nde o wartannoo fu, o fanti waande, o wi'i: " Waande omtu".
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Waande omta fa o heɓa o muynina suka makko de o hoota o waalowa.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Jon le si o yottake, ni o wi'a waande omtu.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Baali ndaɗii kamBaali Manna ndaɗii kamManna fiyan kamManna jooro fiyan kamFiyii kam waran kamWarii kam le welaa kam.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Tan waande omtoo, o muynina suka makko, o ommba, o hoota.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Jaangoore muuɗum gatin, laasara si mo warta (subaka kay si mo yaha) fu o fantan o muynina suka makko.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Laasara si mo warta gadin ni, o wi'a ɗum waande omtu.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Faa ɓooya gatin o wi'a omtu.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Baali ndaɗii kamBaali Manna ndaɗii kamManna fiyan kamManna jooro fiyan kamFiyii kam waran kamWarii kam le welaa kam.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Faa nyannde gom, rawaandu ladde na yiiloo.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Baali, ngari ndaari faa na nana mo wi'a: “Waande omtu."
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Faa ɓooyi tan, o yimi gadin.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: O muynini suka makko de o dilli.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Tawi suka on fuɗɗii mawnude seeɗa faa o waddanii ɗum jawel o watti e jungo muuɗum.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Nde o dillunoo fu, jaangoore muuɗum fadde makko warde fu, rawaandu ladde artii o.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Faa ɓooyi tan kam du yimi wi'i:
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Baali ndaɗii kamBaali Manna ndaɗii kamManna fiyan kamManna jooro fiyan kamFiyii kam waran kamWarii kam le welaa kam.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Tan waande omtii, tan rawaandu ladde hooƴi cukaltel ngel, dillidi, ƴakki.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Yoppi junngo e jakari ley ton.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Faa rawaandu ladde kay dilli tan, inna suka on du warowi.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Faa ɓooyi tan o yimani ɗum, o wi'i:
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Baali ndaɗii kamBaali Manna ndaɗii kamManna fiyan kamManna jooro fiyan kamFiyii kam waran kamWarii kam le welaa kam.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Tan, waande omtinoo fu, o yuurnii, o tawi cukalel makko junngo muuɗum tan e jawo.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: O darii, o wi'i: "Semteende ɓaleere ɓaleere moɗam ko kennaa kam, gaɗa wuro."
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Semteende moɗi mo, henni mo gaɗa wuro.
title: Dey Maana e korɗom

text: Woodiino e nokkure gooɗom, ley ladde, dow laawol luumo, debbo mawɗo na won ton, na wonndi e laayooru muuɗum.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Juulɗe wannoo fu, o jonngi ni, o jonngi ni fa, fa, faa heewi garbuuje makko fu, mo heɗii yimɓe jon kay.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: O yehi o naatoy ley ladde fa o teena leɗɗe.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Laayooru ndu lutti rufi garbuuje makko, rufi fu.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Rufi tan doggiri ley wuro sabu kanko dow laawol o wonnoo.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Nde o warnoo fu, o tawi golle ɗe laayooru makko golli.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Jon kay mo filoo fu yalla moy waddanta mo laayooru ndu, fa o fiya ɗum, o wara ɗum ni jon kay, o fowta.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: O tefi pooli fu fa o nila, o heɓaay, si wanaa o hawroy e dutal.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Nde o noddunooo dutal fu, o wi'i ɗum mi yiɗaanaa ndaaranowaa kam laayooru.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: O wi'i an kay yoppidam ni.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Dutal dilli yehi waɗoy mbaggu muuɗum tan fiiri naati ley wuro.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: To yottii fu si darake tan, to yottii hoɗi dow yooboode suudu maa dow lekki fu, fiya mbaggu muuɗum waɗa:
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Kasum Maamudu iinika dooInaa summbaa, ba siin.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Ɗum wonnoo: " Debbo mawɗo gonnooɗo dow laawol na jonnga bagi o, maayii hannden."
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Tawi nde o dillannoo nde, o wi'i debbo mawɗo on, si na yiɗi laayooru muuɗum warta fu, fukkoo dow daago muuɗum dey hooƴa wudere raneere suddoo, waɗa hono maayɗo nih, fadde makko dillude.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: To o hoɗi fu o ndaara dow laabi, ni o daroo dow lekki.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Kasum Maamudu iinika dooInaa summbaa, ba siin.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Jon kay, o hawri laayooru ley wuro na yiiloo.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: O darii gadin o fiyi mbaggu makko.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Kasum Maamudu iinika dooInaa summbaa, ba siin.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Tan tawii laayooru nanii, ko dem-mawɗo ngonnooɗo dow laawol na jonnga bagi o, Alla muuyii e mwuuɗum hannden.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Nyonoo jon kay, wi'i Alla nih!
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Tan dutal ardii yehi yeeso gadin dow laawol, darii fiyi mbaggu muuɗum gatin wi'i:
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Kasum Maamudu iinika dooInaa summbaa, ba siin.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Tan laayooru ndun na tokka gadin na wi'a:
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Noon ni, dutal na woni yeeso; woɗɗowoke tan fiya mbaggu muuɗum na wi'a dem-mawɗo ngonɗo dow laawol o.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Faa ɓe kaccii to debbo mawɗo woni.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Laayooru na yi'a goɗɗum na fukkii, na suddii wudere raneere.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Faami jon kay wallay yo ngoonga.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Tan dutal nde doomunoo fu, na fiya faa dem-mawɗo na nana na waɗaa:
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Kasum Maamudu iinika dooInaa summbaa, ba siin.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Tan dem-mawɗo na nana laayooru na waɗa:
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Dutal darii ɗo dem-mawɗo oon fukkii ɗon de na wi'a:
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Kasum Maamudu iinika dooInaa summbaa, ba siin.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Faa yottii gannde wudere fa suddita ndaara yalla dem-mawɗo o.
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Tan demmawɗo waɗi ɗum koyngal tap de wi'i: "Mi hunake Alla si wanaa ko nyoninoɗaa kam hannden fu, na mi ittuno yonnki ma!"
title: Dem-mawɗo e laayoorum

text: Wuugaandu e lewla wo yaadiraaɓe sanne.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Jemma e nyalooma fu ɓe ngondu faa nyannde gom tan ɓe muuyi yaroyde ndiyam.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Nde ɓe njahannoo fa ɓe njaroowa fu, lewla wii wuugaandu: "Hannden ka wuugaandu, en njarowa keerkete."
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Wuugaandu nootii o wii: "Hey lewlel, accu ni njarowen mbaaliiɗam.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Saabu dey, kerkete na tiiɗani ma."
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Lewlel wii o, ndelle so ni ɓe njarooytaa keerkete fu, jaadal maɓɓe timmii.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Min kay mi yiɗaa fu ko senndata en.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: En njaha njaarowen keerkete so ɗuum weli ma.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Keerkete le wo ndiyam iiloojam ceeɗu ley gooruuwol hakkunde dubbe koole.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Ɓe njogii ɓe njaha faa ɓe njottii hunnduko gooruuwol tan ɓe ndarii.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Buugalel ɗomɗitilnoo fu, fiiri hoɗowi dow lekki.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Lewlel yardunoo ni luwe ɗisii e ɗaɗi kooli.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Memi ɗoofude luwe e ɗaɗi kooli waaway.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Pooloy keerkete dannga lilifo,ƴoogooɓe maana dannga lilifo,Kamɓoy ina ngara dannga lilifo.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Nde lewlel nanunoo fu, nootii kam du:
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Kiiriri njeecoo dannga lilifo,Kaarara njeeƴo dannga lilifo.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Nde lewlel wiinoo noon fu, heddii na diffoo, na fitta, na fooɗa hoore muuɗum faa wuurtoo, waaway.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: To ƴoogooɓe ton du tawi cukalel kam aardinoo.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Nden cukalel ngel wii womɓe gaɗa muuɗum: "Goɗɗum ya na ton to keerkete to na haala."
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Womɓe gaɗa ɓen, mbi o fenan, o tinnoo tan o yaaha law."
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Nde wuugaandu yiinoo ɓe ngara warde fu, wii gatin:
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Lewlel nde nannoo fu, wii gatin:
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Kiiriri njeeƴoo dannga lilifoKaarara njeeƴo dannga lilifo.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Kiiriri njottoke dannga lilifoKaarara njottoke dannga lilifo.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Den kay himɓe wuro njottii tawi nani lewla na fitta faa tefa wurtagol, waaway.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Ndeen ɓeen njottii kaɓɓi lewlel koyɗe.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Ɓe nanngi hoore muuɗum, ɓe ngatti luwem ley ɗaɗi koole tan, ɓe mbuurtini ɗum yaasin; ɓe kiirsiɗum, ɓe kutti, ɓe cenndi tan ɓe itti baka buugalel ɓe kokki ɗum.
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Tan kam du nde hemnoo bakam fu fiiri furr!
title: Wuugaandu e lewla

text: Waɗiino e jamaanuuji, gorko tawanoo de yo hiran hunnde.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Li'eewa o waɗi, deekiraaɓe makko na njaha na cafowa haabu.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Nyannde gom kaananke ƴeenyi soorowal mum na jooɗii.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: O yi'i worɓe na piloo deekiraaɓe makko.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: O wi'i ɗum, so ngoonga ni kanko won kaananke wuro de no huunde nde, mettiri o, de na o ɗaɓɓa minyiiko, sawaranoo o, ɓe njoppa laamu ngu, de ɓe ndilla ɓe lalla e ladde maɓɓe.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: O wi'i ɓe ndilla nokkuure nde, ndelle.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Na ɓe njaha faa ɓe ngarowi ɓe naati nder ladde yuurummberere.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Ɓe njehi faa nih won jenngii.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Heddii ɓe njottii rotere lekki ɓe ndarii.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Ba ɓe pukkoto ɗoon, ni ɓe mbi'i ikka nde ɓe ƴeenyi koo ndeen ɓuri ndeenaagu.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Ni ɓe kootowi dow lekki ɓe ɗaanii toon.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Tawi jinnaaru du wonnoo nder ladde ɗoon na yaha, na ronndii keesuwal manngal.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Gaɗa jemma jenngii, jinnaaru wi'i jippinan footinoo.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Heddii jippinowi lekki ki kaananke ƴeenji ki.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Rewnoo faa jinaaru men ɗaanii, ni deekum fi keesuwal wuytii.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Nder keesuwal jinnaaru ndu, deekum wonnoo ɗoon.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Kiram saabii de jinnaaru men dilli wuro ngo wonnoo.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Ley keesuwal debbo waalata, ley keesuwal debbo nyallata.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: O ndaari dow; Leƴƴule lekki na moorii na ummanii kammbu.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: O yi'i kaananke e minyum na cekii hakkunde leɗɗe na ɗaani.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: O ƴeenyi lekki o tawi ɓe toon.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Heese heese faa o findini ɓe e dullaangal jinnaaru.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Illa ɓe poofi ɓe nji'ay debbo wooɗiri nih.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Dey jinnaaru ruɗi ɓe mooso maɓɓe.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Ba neeɓan ni dey jinnaaru wi'i: "Jooni yaa gootum woni.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Maa gooto mon jippoke min ngaɗii ko mawɓe jelgooɓe maa mi huuɓii, jinnaaru ndu fina, tappa on faa maayon.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Saboo tawdan en, wooɗi yerum e kiram le walaa."
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Ɓe njiɗaa wadde ko debbo o, haajaa ɗum, na ɓe kulana yonkiiji maɓɓe.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Gooto maɓɓe heddii jipoɗii e dey jinnaaru.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Ɓe njottinnoo fu, suka gorko yeeƴii ɗo wonnoo.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Dey jinnaaru du yeeƴii nder keesu ommbitii.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Ni jinnaaru na fukkii na hara.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Rewnoo faa fajiri yottii, jinnaaru men fini.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Itti ndiyam wuyɓii de heddi nanngi.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Alla waɗi jinnaaru men juuli faa juulidi.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: O ndaari ɗum faa wooɗi de o wi'i: "Saa Alla bada wi'aa aan e gorko on njiidii gadi so wanaa min."
title: Kiram kaananke

text: To kaananke e minyum ngoni to, na nana jinnaaru na haala.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Jinnaaru watti nanni ɗum nder keesu de ronndii keesuwal mum dillidi.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Kaananke e minyum gorko anndunoo ko ɓe mboɗɗoke ni njippii.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: Minyiyo o, noddi mawnum faa nootii de wi'i: "A yi'ii ko dey jinna waɗi.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: En koota wuro men, kawritowen e suudu baaba."
title: Kiram kaananke

text: So neɗɗo hirii sanne fu, yeggitaanaa kiirndam.
title: Kiram kaananke

text: No o wanyiri suudu baaba de o eggi o hoɗowi feere makko nder ladde.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: No o wannyiri suudu baaba ni,
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: So o aawi gawri yo bogodollo fudata.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Yimɓe memi nannude gorko o suudu baaba,
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: O hollaama koo sennditaade suudu bammum wooɗaa,
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: o hollaama koo sennditaade nyiɓa cuuɗim kam tan wooɗaa.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: O wi'i o nanngan tonnyannde artiinde nde o jonnga.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: O hawrondini jeɗɗi foondu o tummbi e faannde makko.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Wuro woni faa lettugal wuro neɗɗo men.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Tewtooɓe tato ngari ɗo neɗɗo men njeeka molu kaananke.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: O wi'i ɓe o yi'ay molu kaananke,
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: O yiɗaa yimɓe wuro baabiiko sakko yimɓe wuro baaba goɗɗo.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Haala gorko o naawii yimɓe ɓe.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Ɓe nyonyondiri faa ɓe liɓowi faande dekinoonde e kaatane.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Koyɗe pooli njuwi ngaylii koyɗe puccu.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Ɓe mbi'i tilay ɓe mbara mbanyungel suudu baaba.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Wi'i ɓe njaaran o ɗo kaananke.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Wi'aa o naata o heɓinoo heɓa o yaaree wuro kaankanke.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: o ɓornii saaya makko de o adi jammbere makko o wakkii.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Ɓe fu ɓe ndewndiri faa e danki kaananke.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Ɓe mbi'i ɓe tawaana gorko o na jonnga koyɗe molu.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Gorko fitti faa hooti dow de yeddi.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: O wi'i cofal makko tonnyata pooli.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: O nanngi pooli to'nyannde arandeere o joongi.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Kanko le o anndaa noy waɗi de koyɗe pooli makko narnditi e koyɗe molu.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Illa o yottinay haala makko de hewɓe mbi'i o tappee o waree.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Heddii o ƴami suudu baaba neɗɗel.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Ɗo o wari heɓa o ummoo ɗo hore makko fii leggal danki kaananke.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Leggal heli ɗisowii e yitere kaananke nande.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Nde footere ni yimɓe caami e makko tappi o mbari.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Ngol taalol hollataanaa koo yimɓe leeɓaa ndewtondira bonde.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Leeɓaanaa cuurondira dagu no suudu baaba muy runoo suurirde neɗɗo bonɗo o nih.
title: 64 Caliiɗo suudu baaba

text: Nde njilnga adunoo laawol ni cofal yi'i ɗum.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Ba neeɓan seeɗa ni ŋuusu ɓaaƴi ɓe.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: uusu ƴami cofal toy ɓoy njaata.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: uusu wi'i kam du ɗootan ɓe.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Nde ɓe njottondirnoo fu ɓe njootondiri faa jootiiru yottii.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: ko'dal e yi'de de na ɗooti kam.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Ɓoosel wi'i min du mi ɗootete.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: na ɓe njaha faa ɗo ɓe kawri leengaa.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Leengaa haalani ɓe koo be'el jootoyta ko yawnoo wuro esiraaɓem de warti.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Ɓoosel haalani leengaa koo be'el heɓay warti.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Dey be'el o hawri na yaha weendu.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Leenga wi'i so be'el wartay ni heddoto ɗootira ɓe.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Njiiwa ƴami leengaa ɗo ɓoy njaata.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Ɓoosel wi'i ta ƴamam ƴamu nguusu.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: kamɓe du ɓe njewta faa ɗo jilngel moorodi de ɓe paɗitoo ɓe kiirnida kiikiiɗe.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Mboddi ƴami ɓe faa toy ɓe njaata.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Ɓe mbi'i mboddi taa ƴama ɓe,
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: yo koddal e yidde de na ɗooti kam."
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Mboddi so lawlawtii ni yoppa daasoo,
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: "Anndii moy ardii jahaangal ngal de na ngal naaliraa nih.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Moy le ardii so wanaa njilngel.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: A moɗataa meere o de ardoɗaa jahaangal heɓa njehen law."
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Heddii turii adi njilngel moɗi de ardii jahaangal.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: So bollel lawlawtii ni yeeƴoo daasoo,
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: No jahaangal ngal yaarata nih welay mboddi,
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: "Anndi moy ardii jahaangal ngal de na ngal naaliraa nih.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Moy le ardii so wanaa cofel.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Aan cofel ardiima na hanndire nih.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: A harataako meere o moɗaa de ardoɗaa jahaangal heɓa njehen law."
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Heddii turii adi de ardii jahaangal.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Neeɓunoo seeɗa ni mboddi watti ƴami:
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Leenga moɗi ɓoosel de ardii jahaangal.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Ɗo ɓe njaata ɗo ni njiiwa yeeƴitii wi'i mboddi:
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Mboddi anndunoo koo njiiwa sommii ni ƴami:
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: "Anndi moy ardii jahaangal ngal de na ngal naaliraa nih.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: So yimɓe njappataa ni yo njawɗoto ba yo baaniye rewi ɓoy."
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Njiiwa wi'i moy le ardii so wanaa leengaa.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Mboddi wi'i yo aan jaasi de leengaa na tampinira en nih.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Ko jaasi leendu sakko anon kawtata jahaangal.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Ɓottu leɗɗe e huɗo ngaddaa mi lakkitirane pimpiti o."
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Njiiwa itti huɗo e leɗɗe hokki mboddi watti e nofo njiiwa.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Ba neeɓan ni bayaare ummii e noppi nyiiwa.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Ndelle Alla wallu en e mbo'diijo.
title: 65 Moorgol njilngel

text: Ndemoowo wonnoo de deekum yo kulo Alla.
title: 66 Bonde

text: So ndemoowo e dukum na njaha ngesa,
title: 66 Bonde

text: Noon nih faa haala makko waraana haalee.
title: 66 Bonde

text: Yeru makko e hulude Alla walaa.
title: 66 Bonde

text: Jaka ko haala kulol Alla dey-ndemoowo o,
title: 66 Bonde

text: tewtowi mbarduɗum watti nder loonde dey ndemoowo e dullaangal mum.
title: 66 Bonde

text: adi loondem hebinni ndiyam dagu no e bada nih.
title: 66 Bonde

text: O ronndii o joƴinoy hakkunde ngesa.
title: 66 Bonde

text: Mbarduɗum soofi nder loonde e dullaangal adunaaru.
title: 66 Bonde

text: Nde naange fuɗunoo faa na'i ɓiraa ɓirdaa,
title: 66 Bonde

text: O duri ɗi faa naannge ɓantii.
title: 66 Bonde

text: O doomunoo ngesa ndemoowo ni o dogani loonde.
title: 66 Bonde

text: O yari fa o ɗomɗiti de o sakitii o jooti ndemoowo e koreejim.
title: 66 Bonde

text: Ni foortowii e leydi na talloo.
title: 66 Bonde

text: Ndeen ndemoowo e koreejim annditi koo yo o naawete.
title: 66 Bonde

text: Fu ndoggi ngari kawri dow hoore makko.
title: 66 Bonde

text: Jom ngesa ƴami o ko hewtii o.
title: 66 Bonde

text: O wi'i yo ndiyam loonde nde,
title: 66 Bonde

text: o facci o yari de naawu ummorii o.
title: 66 Bonde

text: Nde wootere ni dey ndemoowo fii nyonaango:
title: 66 Bonde

text: Ɓi neɗɗo maani e neɗɗo maani maayii."
title: 66 Bonde

text: Ba neɓtan ni adunaaru diri hawri.
title: 66 Bonde

text: Tawnoo ɓiyum na waalii ni fii nyonaago.
title: 66 Bonde

text: O dawray ni o wi'i koo kanko wattunoo mbarduɗum nder loonde dey ndemoowo o.
title: 66 Bonde

text: O wi'i kanko e dey ndemoowo njaadata.
title: 66 Bonde

text: Yimɓe fu yo oo to njiɗi.
title: 66 Bonde

text: Ɗuum waɗi de o muuyi mettinde ɓeerndem.
title: 66 Bonde

text: saboo kiram na wanna on ko on ummanaaki.
title: 66 Bonde

text: Ɓe ndimi ɓiiɓe na wi'ee Kanaana.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Wari yonii ko Kanaana tewtanee kaddungal.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Baaba Kanaana tewtiri haabu duuɓi jeɗɗi.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Inna kanaana mottiri haabu duuɓi jeegom waɗi gaaraaji palle e geese.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Cannyoowo sannyiri gaaraaji ɗi duuɓi joy.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Njootoowo nyootiri saaya Kanaana duuɓi nay.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: duuɓi noogay e ɗiɗi saaya ka adi.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Fini subaka saaya waraa hokkitaa baaba Kanaana.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Mi termii heɓande ma saaya mi waaway.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Jon kay no ngaɗɗaa fu na mi yarli."
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Kanaana wi'i so bammum yarloke ni gasii.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Nde weeti fu o yeeyan ɗo o heɓoyta saaya njottiika o.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: O wi'i walaa ɗo yehee walaa ɗo yeeƴee.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Heddii o wi'i o naatan e maayo ngo,
title: 67 Kanaana

text: o maaya heɓa o hewta hoore makko.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Maayo na daɗɗii na lalli e ladde.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Walaa fu ko eelata so wanaa mayde.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: O yehi faa ndiyam waddi o koppi.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: O yaari balɗe jeɗɗi sakitii ndiyam waddi o wuddu.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: O watti o yaari balɗe jeɗɗi,
title: 67 Kanaana

text: o wari o tawi lugginam weendu yo ɓuytoto.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Ndiyam ɓuytii faa warti o koppi.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Ndeen noon o ƴeewi kammbu o wi'i:
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Poola moɗi o ba cofal moɗata gabel siiniiri.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Poola moɗunoo Kanaana ni ummanii daande maayo.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Tawi nanaa liwre na fira warde.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Liwre men moɗi poola moɗunoonga Kanaana de heddii heɗii ko warata weendu heɓa yara ndiyam,
title: 67 Kanaana

text: heɓa heɓa ɗuum du moɗa hebbita reedum.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Ndelle no Alla waari neɗɗo fu,
title: 67 Kanaana

text: ɗum yetta saboo tawan hunngataako dagum.
title: 67 Kanaana

text: Dagu no o yiɗiri oo to nih,
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Ngayngu oo to du yo noon ta noon.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Nyannde gom ɓe njehi ɗo moodibbo ɓe tewtowa du'aa'u heɓa ɓe ndanya.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Ɓe njottinoo ni moodibbo winndi dalliili hokki ɓe.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Heddii o wi'i ɓe ceeda nyanndem.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Mbiituɗo lettugal o won njiɗɗo jaadom.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Mbiituɗo gorgal o won jom ngayngu.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: O warowi o yii ɓokki makki njogiiki luuro.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Gaɗa jemma jenngii ni o naati e luuro ɗoon heɓa o waala.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: ɗii to koɗi dow ɓokki kiin.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: To ɗi ngoni to yo ɗi kiiran.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Haala waddi haala ni wooturu majji wi'i:
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: "So ngoonga ni wuro maaniiwo na ɗomɗi hannde.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Na mi anndi no ngo watta de ndiyam hoya ngo de mi haalantaa yimɓe maggo,
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: "Hayre woni gaɗa ɓaade kaananke wuro ngoon.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Hayre nde yo hunnduko ɓunndu ommbi.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: ndiyam ɓunndu ndu hantataako e bada".
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: "Bumɗo na woni wuro lettugaawo to hannde.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Na mi anndi ko wumtinta o de mi haalanoytaa o,
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: "On nji'ii ɓokki ki ngonɗen dow mum ki,
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: nde o uraa haako makki fu o wumtan."
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Weetunoo ni gorko men wurtii ɗo wonnoo.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: O yehi o weeranowi kaananke wuro ɗomɗungo ngo.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: O yottinoo ni o waɗi yimɓe kawrondinaa.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: O waali na o waajoo ɓe.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Rewnoo faa weeti ni kaananke wi'i du'aa'u ɗaɓata o.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: O wi'i ɗomka haajaa warude o,
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Beero men wi'i ɗuum walaa e du'aa'u.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: O nodda maccuɓe nayo o wadda.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Jaka kaaja yo hunnduko ɓunndu ommbunoo.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Nano e nyaamo fu yo liƴƴi pittata.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Gaɗa kaananke heɓii ɓunndu heewundu ndiyam ni ɓeerndem welii.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: O waɗi gorko men hokkoraa na'i hemnde,
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Ni o ɗaɓɓi laawol heɓa o hoota.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: O yottinoo ni o jippanii gorko bumɗo o.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: O waali na o waajoo mbumndi e koreejim faa weeti.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Aan jey so a waawii a waɗii du'aa'u mi wumtii."
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Tawi gorko men ittiino haako ɓogga luuro na loowi.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: O itti ƴulɓe o watti e heeɗoore.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Gorko men suɓii surbaaɓe tato ɓurɓe wodde,
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: baalim e be'im de adi laawol wuro bammum.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Wanaa ko heɓay fay gootum ɗum waani o,
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Heddii jaadiyo dillirnooɗo lettugal o wi'i:
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: "En ɗaɓɓiino du'aa'u faddemen dillude tewtiiru jawdi.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Mi waɗan jawdi am ndi ngeɗuuji tati.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: min du mi ada ngeɗu ngootu."
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Haajaakanaa o holla ɗum no o waɗi de o heɓowi jawdi ndi.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Oo to du heddii yottii nder wuro.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Naange hiirunoo ni gorko jammbuujo yottii ɓogga luuro.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Rewnoo faa jenngi ni pooli ngari keewi dow ɓokki ɗoon.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Wooturu yoppi wi'i ɓii-aadama luuɓata ɗum.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Ndu ndaari faa ndu ndaari nder luuro ɓokki.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Ndelle ta bonu e jaado maa.
title: 68 Jaadiraaɓe ɗiɗo

text: Jinni njoginoo garuwal muɓɓoy nder ladde yuurummbereere.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Nde hiiri fu ɓe ndilla ɓe njoppa garuwal ngal,
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: de ɓe mbaancowoo faa jennga de ɓe ngarta.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Walaa fu nyaamdu ndu ɓe ngalaa nder garuwal ngal.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Nyannde gom bojel wari faamani nyaamdu jinni ɗi.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: O yehi o memi omtude dammugal garuwal o hunngorii.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: O wi'i o moggoto o heɗoo jinni ɗi ngarta;
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: so ngarii na naata ni o annditan to dammbugal heedi.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Ndeen o wartonowan nyaamdu jinni ɗi.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Ɓe ngarnoo heɓa ɓe ndilla ni ɓe mbi'i:
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: de jemma wari faa jinni ndilli fu,
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Ni wuytoo faa wuytodoo de wi'a:
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Njuuraa walaa fu ko waɗay de heɓay ko nyaama.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Njuuraa warowi taykii koo ɗo rafo ngo woodi ɗo fu,
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Ndelle njuuraa yehi ɗo bojel heɓa faamitowoo ko woni.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: so ngoonga ni won ɗo njiitum na mi yaha jemma jemma.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: So neɗɗo yehii toon tawan sifaaji nyaamduuji ɗi ngalanaa reere.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: De so mi hollii ma ni a waɗan nanngeɗen".
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Heddii njuuraa yamiri bojel saabe Alla.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Bojel wari tawi walaa fu no waɗa.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Ɓe ndewondiri faa e garuwal jinni.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: O holli njuuraa ko jey wadde so na haajaa naatude maa wuytaade garuwal jinni.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: So a doomii dammbugal ngal ni mbi'aa garu yaynu,
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Naataa nyaamaa faa kaaraa de ittaa nyaamdu njaaranaa koreeji maa.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: So a anndii koo a wuytoke garuwal ngal,
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Nyanndem ɓe keddii ɓe ndewondiri ɓe naati nder garuwal ngal.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Ɓe nyaami faa ɓe kaari de ɓe mbuytii.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: o yeggiti koo leeɓanaa o wuytoo de o wi'a garu niɓu,
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Kanko kaa nder garuwal toon o heddii de na o jogorii garu niɓɓu,
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Tawraa noon faa jom garuwal en ngarowi ngarti.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Jinni njottinoo ni mbi'i ko mboowunoo wi'ude.
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: teewu ngu kokkuɗaa kam ngu yo heewu ƴi'e."
title: 69 Bojel, njuuraa e

text: Inniiko jaabii wi'i so heewu ƴi'e ni o faɗɗa de o itta teewuure wonnde.
